species.tagline: Its caterpillars grow up on citrus leaves

tasks.title: Find the tails
tasks.message: Its hindwings end in two tail-like points — that is why it is a swallowtail.
tasks.subtitle: Hello! This is an Asian swallowtail. Its hindwings end in two tail-like points.

tasks.title: What it ate as a baby
tasks.message: Its caterpillars grow up eating citrus leaves.
tasks.subtitle: As a caterpillar it eats citrus leaves — which is why you find it on lemon trees.

tasks.title: How to help
tasks.message: No citrus tree means no Asian swallowtail.
tasks.subtitle: Without citrus trees the caterpillars have nothing to eat. Keeping the tree matters. Thank you!
